name: @cver/coral-drawer
description: An overlay drawer as a dynamic coral — depth without pages. Mount [data-dynamic-coral=drawer] over a layer of [data-drawer-panel] panels; triggers are [data-drawer=<id>]. Opening is pure CSS (:has(:checked)), so it works before the script arrives; JS adds the focus trap, Escape, focus restore and hash deep-links. Shares the close button's identity with the qr coral. Version covers the UNIT: the client JS + the data-* contract + the dc-drawer-* class names.
